notes:
The first test version. Thank you for trying it!

- Type a name or draw shapes at their real size, on a page that is your material (a coaster, a board, a sheet), placed where it sits on your laser.
- Pick fonts, arch text, change the spacing between letters, and add borders and shadows that follow the words.
- Bring in a picture and trace it into shapes or single lines.
- Join shapes, cut one out of another, and edit their points.
- Line things up with rulers, guidelines, a grid and smart guides; they snap into place as you drag.
- Hold Ctrl to keep things straight, square or round, and Shift to size from the center.
- Copy things in a line, a fan or a spiral with Ctrl D, or fill your material with copies using Step and repeat.
- Preview exactly what the laser will do, then frame it, burn a test square, and make it.
- Save your designs as SVG files that other programs can open.
- Made ready for the Mecpow X3 Pro: choose it under Your machine in the Machine panel, and its materials start at settings for its 10 W laser.
- New versions arrive by themselves: a bar at the top offers them, and Install now keeps your design open.
